selection_mechanism.label: VERIFIED
algorithm: else if !ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> return {success:false, error:'No LLM provider configured...'}
selection_mechanism.finding: Provider is chosen by AMBIENT ENVIRONMENT (which API-key variables happen to be set), not by the caller. A caller that asks for a Claude model on a machine where ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is absent but OPENROUTER_API_KEY is present is served by OpenRouter instead, with no error, no warning, and no field in the result identifying the substitution.

caller_can_pin_provider.detail: RUFLO_PROVIDER=anthropic|openrouter|ollama forces the branch, but it is a PROCESS-WIDE ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE, not a per-call argument. AgentExecuteInput has no provider field. There is no per-request provider pin.

caller_can_pin_model.anthropic_path: YES — input.model is passed through verbatim
caller_can_pin_model.openrouter_path: PARTIAL — resolveOpenAICompatModel(input.model, input.defaultModel); when the caller passes a bare Anthropic id the effective slug becomes an OpenRouter slug (default 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6', overridable by OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_MODEL). The caller's requested identity is remapped, not honoured verbatim.
caller_can_pin_model.ollama_path: PARTIAL — resolveOllamaModel(input.model) maps logical names onto Ollama Cloud defaults.

harness_model_pinned_without_consent.label: VERIFIED
harness_model_pinned_without_consent.detail: `ruflo init` writes "model": "claude-sonnet-5" into the project's .claude/settings.json, plus claudeFlow.modelPreferences = {default: claude-sonnet-5, routing: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001}. This silently sets the model for the entire host project.

independent_execution_trace.label: VERIFIED
independent_execution_trace.detail: The success shape AnthropicCallResult is {success, model?, messageId?, stopReason?, output?, usage?, durationMs?, error?}. It has NO provider field, NO endpoint field, and NO base-URL field. `providerLabel` exists only as an INPUT to callOpenAICompat and is interpolated solely into ERROR strings, never into a success result. The module's own doc comment states the intent explicitly: 'Response shape is normalized to the Anthropic-flavored AnthropicCallResult so existing callers don't need to know which provider answered.'
independent_execution_trace.consequence: Given only a successful result, a caller cannot determine which vendor endpoint served the request. `model` echoes the provider's self-reported string, which is provider-attested, not independently attested. There is no signed receipt, no endpoint hash, and no per-call trace record binding a response to an endpoint.

gateway_bypass.label: VERIFIED
gateway_bypass.detail: dist/src/mcp-tools/agent-execute-core.js:111 issues fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages') against a HARDCODED literal. dist/src/mcp-tools/managed-agent-tools.js:20 uses process.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL when set. The two Anthropic call sites in the same package disagree.
gateway_bypass.consequence_for_dime: the agent platform routes ALL Claude traffic (anthropicClient.ts, dimeAgent.ts, piAgent.ts, Claude Code CLI) through an Anthropic-compatible gateway via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN. Ruflo's agent_execute path would egress directly to api.anthropic.com, outside that gateway, and would additionally require a raw ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (it sends x-api-key, not the gateway's auth token).

cloud_routing_by_default.label: VERIFIED
cloud_routing_by_default.verdict: NO cloud routing to the vendor is on by default, but a vendor-content FETCH is on by default.
evidence: consent.js: getConsent() returns {granted:false} for every unrecorded domain; hasConsent() additionally requires the receipt to match the current CONSENT_POLICY_VERSION.

proxy.js: default_data_plane defaults to 'passthrough' ('requests go to your own Claude subscription. Prompts do not go to Cognitum.'); 'cloud' requires an explicit `ruflo proxy config --cloud --yes` which calls recordConsent('cloud-routing', true, ...).
proxy status offline: 'Installation: not installed' — the meta-proxy is NOT installed by `npm i` or by `ruflo init`.
COUNTERWEIGHT: refreshRemoteMessages() has NO consent gate at all. `ruflo doctor` reported: 'Funnel (ADR-305): enabled (decided by: package-default; disclosure: never_seen)'.

what_the_disclosure_actually_is.label: VERIFIED
what_the_disclosure_actually_is.detail: `ruflo proxy config` with no flags prints a plain-language statement of which data plane is active and who serves the request, via describePlane(): cloud -> 'Cloud routing is ON — cloud-tier requests go to api.cognitum.one.'; passthrough -> 'requests go to your own Claude subscription. Prompts do not go to Cognitum.'; local -> 'requests go to your own backend (Ollama/vLLM/SGLang) and never leave this machine.'; sponsored -> "requests go to Cognitum's sponsored capacity". Enabling cloud routing requires --cloud --yes and records a consent receipt; disabling revokes it. A separate ADR-311 'disclosure' message row exists in the statusline funnel, whose state doctor reports as disclosure: never_seen.
what_the_disclosure_actually_is.scope_limit: The disclosure covers ONLY the meta-proxy data plane. It says nothing about the agent_execute provider-fallback ladder (Anthropic -> OpenRouter -> Ollama Cloud), which is the path an integrator would actually hit, and which has no disclosure surface at all.

tier_pinning.label: VERIFIED
tier_pinning.detail: routing_mode ∈ {auto, low, mid, high} written to ~/.ruflo/proxy-config.toml; absent means 'auto'. Applies only while the cloud plane is active. 'auto' means the vendor picks the tier — i.e. the model class — on the user's behalf.

credential_handling.label: VERIFIED
observations: Anthropic path sends the raw ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as the x-api-key header.

Cognitum refresh tokens are persisted to the OS keychain via @napi-rs/keyring, which is an OPTIONAL dependency — absent from the --omit=optional install variant, so the keychain-backed storage path is not guaranteed present.
`ruflo auth login --token-stdin` accepts a JSON credential object on stdin.

Empirical: with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY='sk-ant-LEAKCANARY0001' and a DB URL containing a canary set in the environment, neither canary appeared in .swarm/, .claude-flow/, ~/.ruflo/, ~/.claude-flow/ or .claude/ after doctor + status + memory store. No environment-secret leakage into artifacts was observed.

tailered_section_16_verdict.label: VERIFIED
reasons: Model identity must come only from tailered.config.json; Ruflo takes provider identity from ambient environment variables and writes its own model pin into .claude/settings.json.
There is no independent trace proving which endpoint and model executed — the success result deliberately erases the provider.
The stateless-router invariant is violated by a process-wide RUFLO_PROVIDER selector with no per-call provider argument.
A silent cross-vendor substitution (Anthropic -> OpenRouter -> Ollama Cloud) is reachable by nothing more than an unset environment variable.
